note: density/TC labels and folds unchanged from canonical_molecules.csv; viscosity rebuilt dynamic-only (dynamic rows verbatim from original table, kinematic rows converted via nu*rho) with conversion before deduplication
post_patches: mol_00305 bis(2-ethylhexyl) sebacate: viscosity, density and thermal-conductivity labels added from NIST WTT (kv 11.616/3.141 cSt x rho 0.89925/0.85654 g cm-3). The molecule keeps fold 4, so its released predictions come from the fold-4 models, which never saw it in training and therefore give a genuine out-of-fold value. The models for the other four folds were not retrained afterwards, so their training sets omit this one molecule; with 799 and 804 viscosity labels the effect on any other prediction is negligible.
molecules_note: 1,114 unique molecules result from deduplicating the source entries; 279 of them retain no usable label after unit conversion and conflict screening and are not released, leaving 835 labelled molecules
source_note: Per-label source methods for density and thermal conductivity are recovered from the source databases' retained method fields; 'Method not recovered' marks labels whose method field could not be recovered, and 'NIST WTT' marks the bis(2-ethylhexyl) sebacate labels added per post_patches.
